title: The Award-Winning American Cheese Board
h1: American Cheese Board: Six Award-Winning American Cheeses
seo_title: American Cheese Board: 6 Award-Winning American Cheeses for 10
description: An American cheese board for 10 with six farmstead styles: alpine, spruce-bark soft cheese, clothbound cheddar, ash-ripened goat, cave-aged blue and washed rind, with honeycomb and pears.
hook: This is where $250 goes furthest for cheese lovers: six American farmstead cheeses in six different styles, the kind that win national competitions, from a good cheese shop.

items.name: Champagne grapes or red grapes, 1 lb

why: Six cheeses in six styles means every one tastes different: a nutty alpine, a spoonable spruce-bark round, a craggy clothbound cheddar, a tangy ash-ripened goat, a cave-aged blue and a funky washed rind. Cutting each one its own way tells guests they are six different cheeses.

Space the strong ones apart so the washed rind and blue don't overpower the alpine and goat. Honeycomb softens the blue and the goat, apple butter goes with the cheddar, and juicy pears are the best palate cleanser between strong cheeses.

timeline.what: Cut each cheese its own way.
Peel back the top rind on the spruce-bark round.
Slice the pears; set out the honeycomb.

faq.q: What are the best American cheeses for a cheese board?
faq.a: Pick one of each style: an alpine (Gruyère-style) cheese, a spruce-bark soft cheese, a clothbound cheddar, an ash-ripened goat cheese, a cave-aged blue and a washed rind. A good cheese shop can point you to the award winners in each style.

faq.q: How much does an American artisan cheese board cost?
faq.a: This one comes to about $196 for 10 from a cheese shop at regular fall 2026 prices, before shipping if you order online. Using 8 oz wedges of the alpine and cheddar saves about $17.50.

faq.q: How do you serve a spruce-bark cheese?
faq.a: Peel back the top rind and set a small spoon in it. This style is meant to be spooned, not sliced.
